scientific_integrity: Exact elementary proof plus rational finite checks, no independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact real quotient norm for the complete symmetric Walsh quadratic only; no all-coefficient, complex or higher-degree extension and no second-order asymptotic. The motivating Walsh-tail paper has primary MSC 42C10; the new claim is classified by its Banach quotient-norm geometry under 46B20. The original-result comparison is qualified, not a proof of priority.
title: Exact symmetric quadratic quotient norms on the Boolean cube
